sources.name: GigaHubs Process Review
sources.coverage: 2021-26 GigaHubs delivery processes, public-sector sites and impact pathways
sources.role: Latest process-quality evidence for public-building gigabit interventions
sources.limitations: Programme/process evidence; does not establish broadband availability for a private parcel

sources.name: GigaHubs Process Review Summary
sources.coverage: Summary of approximately 1,200 GigaHub connections delivered in 2021-26 and wider impact pathways
sources.limitations: Aggregate programme findings cannot be assigned to an individual nearby property

sources.name: GigaHubs Process Review Theory of Change
sources.coverage: Theory of change for public-building connections and possible beyond-the-Hub rural expansion
sources.role: Interpretation control for claimed spillover benefits
sources.limitations: Theory of change is causal framework, not measured parcel coverage

sources.name: GigaHub Process Review Annex
sources.coverage: Data/modelling scoping and case-study approach used in the GigaHubs evaluation
sources.limitations: Evaluation-method documentation does not prove local availability

sources.name: GigaHubs Process Review Interview Framework
sources.coverage: Interview design for local-authority leads, suppliers and policy makers
sources.limitations: Interview instrument itself is not outcome or coverage data

sources.name: BDUK Hubs Evaluation Plan
sources.coverage: Evaluation plan for RGC Hubs and GigaHubs from 2024 to 2027
sources.limitations: Plan/milestones are not current parcel connectivity measurements

sources.name: BDUK Rural Gigabit Connectivity Hubs Evaluation
sources.coverage: Observed impacts of earlier rural Hub connections on availability, uptake and public buildings
sources.role: Historical empirical baseline for Hub spillover claims
sources.limitations: Older RGC programme and evaluation period; cannot be treated as current local serviceability

sources.name: BDUK school benefit survey results
sources.coverage: Survey evidence on rural school connectivity, performance perceptions and technology use
sources.limitations: Surveyed schools are not representative of nearby homes/businesses
